integrity: The forward SIRVS equilibrium formula and classical rational/Laplace tools are attributed; the contribution is the exact inverse-dose identifiability boundary. No independent validation or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Perfect equilibrium responses; known reproduction number, mean infectious and vaccine-immunity durations; an unchanged immunity law over vaccination regimes. No statistical noise, numerical stability or unknown-parameter identifiability claims.
title: Sharp finite-dose identifiability of waning immunity in an age-structured SIRVS model
